Overview

This feature service provides line features for active transportation facility types in the district of Peachland. It supports a focused view of transportation infrastructure related to walking, cycling, and other active travel corridors.

Feature Layer

  • Active Transportation Facility Type Lines — Line-based features that identify active transportation facilities and associated project information, including priority and status details for planning and management.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the district of Peachland, British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Reviewing and mapping active transportation corridors
  • Supporting transportation planning and project tracking
  • Displaying facility status and priority information for operational use
  • Integrating active transportation assets into local GIS applications and Open Data portals

Source and Access

Owned by the district of Peachland, published by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License.
